note: W2 PCB-PWRB, W2 B2B, W2 PCB-PWRB-2. Generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_B/make_spec.py (do not hand-edit; rerun it). Placement and the scripted copper are design choices of these packages (build/15 rows W2 PCB-PWRB, W2 B2B and W2 PCB-PWRB-2); the board is the full L of the W2 MECH-7 contract, the PWR-A cut-outs are kept free of parts and scripted copper but not cut yet (pwr_a_cutouts: their Edge.Cuts wait for the contract); the J209 pin map is the graph (pcb/generated/b2b-nets.json contacts). KiCad DRC, the audits and check_boards are CI/model results. Not a fabrication release; mezzanine fit, heat and every bench gate stay OPEN.

layers.source: W2 PWRB-R layers6 study and W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6: 6 layers JLC06161H-2116 1.6 mm, the stackup of the 6-layer CTRL (W2 CTRL-R / CTRL-4; pcb/generated/stackup-6l.json from pcb/stackup.py, jlcpcb.com/impedance read 2026-11-12), ordered with finished outer copper 2 oz and inner 0.5 oz (copper_option outer_2oz, jlcpcb.com read 2026-11-13): the power classes take their 2 oz outer widths (PWR1A 0.2 mm). 1.6 mm is the order thickness; the contract gives PWR_B its own stackup (mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR_B stackup: t 1.664 MODEL with 2 oz outer, 6 layers, order 1.6 +/- 10 %, W2 MECH-8), which the mechanics use
layers.types_why: S-G-S-S-P-S as the 6-layer CTRL: In1.Cu (L2) a solid GND plane 0.2234 mm under F.Cu, so the LAB5 trunk, the TPS2553 switches, the Kelvin shunts and the LNA bias filters (XAL5030 inductors, dampers) on F.Cu keep a solid return plane directly below; In4.Cu (L5) a solid 3V3_Q6A plane (the 20-pad monitor supply that crosses from the bar to the arm), both typed power so Freerouting routes no trace on them. In2.Cu (L3) and In3.Cu (L4) are the routing layers the stackup adds; every routing layer faces a plane (F.Cu-L2 0.2234 mm, L3-L2 0.3 mm, L4-L5 0.3 mm, B.Cu-L5 0.2234 mm). The power classes route on F.Cu/B.Cu only (router.class_layers): inner copper is 0.5 oz (PWR1A would need 1.8 mm there, netclasses.json inner_min_width_mm)

plan.In1.Cu: L2: solid GND plane (pre-route zone, layer type power: the router puts only vias through it)
plan.In2.Cu: L3: signal routes (no power class), no pour (W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6)
plan.In3.Cu: L4: signal routes (no power class), no pour (W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6)
plan.In4.Cu: L5: solid 3V3_Q6A plane (pre-route zone, layer type power); every SMD 3V3_Q6A pad has a scripted via
plan.B.Cu: L6: B2B half J209 (bottom), its GND spine and contact escapes, LAB5 stubs, power and signal routes, GND pour

planned_cutouts.why: W2 PWRB-R (review F2 of W2 PCB-PWRB-2), the only cut-out key since W2 PWR-TOOLS: the PWR-A cut-outs of pwr_a_cutouts become holes or notches of PWR-B once the MECH lineage writes them into the contract, so no copper may cross them now: each rect grown by margin_mm 0.33 (copper-to-edge 0.3 + 0.03; the scripted copper keeps 0.35) is a rule area on all six copper layers that blocks tracks, vias, pads and zone fills, so Freerouting routes around it, the planes and pours leave it free and KiCad DRC reports any copper in it; the board_gen report (planned_cutout_audit) and pcb/check_boards.py planned_cutouts measure every copper item of the routed board against the rects

router.why: the fan-out pre-pass escaped every SMD pin with necked-down (0.1124 mm) stubs and dangling vias, and the router re-routed the scripted nets because locked copper that crosses a pad is no connection for it (route run 42414083566): fan-out off, the scripted classes not autorouted; GND is joined by the scripted plane vias of every SMD GND pad (run 42415437982 left 83 GND connections open)
